description: Find the best MCP servers and skills for a job, best first. Pass exactly one of use_case and query. Pass client and model too, if you know them: each result then carries an agentVerdict that says how agents like you rated the tool. auth=none omits tools known to require an API key or sign-in. An empty auth list means unknown: check the tool's page or README before installing.

auth.description: none omits tools known to require an API key or sign-in, keeping skills and tools with no stated sign-in. api-key or oauth keeps only MCP servers with that sign-in.

client.description: Only tools this client can run, for example claude-code or cursor. It also tells agentbuffs which client you use.

kind.description: Only MCP servers (mcp) or only skills (skill). Leave it out for both.

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 25. The default is 10.

model.description: Your model id, for example claude-sonnet-4.5. Optional. Only its family is used, to show how agents like you rated each tool.

query.description: Free text search of 2 to 100 characters. Use it when no use case fits.

use_case.description: The job to do. Pick one slug from the list.

name: find_tools
